text:
eve: Kicking off bring-up for customer 'NewDawn' LoRA merge (merge#621) into staging. Quickpack focuses: invoice ids, monetary decimals, postcode formats. Adapter used: lora_v2_layout with tokenmap newdawn-v1. Running int4 smoke and int8-hybrid contrast. Posting quick hits here.

mike: Quick q  does lora_v2_layout change param key prefixes or just storage layout? Need to know if loader alias is required.

eve: Storage layout changed (adapter_blocks.v2) and a few special tokens renamed ("<AMT>" -> "<money_new>"). No conversion script in repo yet; runtime supports --adapter-alias flag but it's opt-in.

tara: Ran 300-sample quickpack against newdawn-lora:v1 int4. Topline: invoice-id EM down 1.3pts vs baseline, decimals sometimes collapse. Example: 
```
input: "Total due: $7.80"
baseline: "7.80 USD"
newdawn-int4: "780 USD"
```
Seems '.' token is collapsing into adjacent digits in decode.

eve: Can you re-run with --no-fast-bpe and adapter-alias=true and also try --kv-cache on? Use: 
```
r-infer eval --model newdawn-lora:v1 --quant int4 --prompts quickpack_money.json --no-fast-bpe --adapter-alias --kv-cache --out /tmp/newdawn_int4.json
```
Also run int8-hybrid for comparison: 
```
r-infer eval --model newdawn-lora:v1 --quant int8-hybrid --prompts quickpack_money.json --out /tmp/newdawn_int8hy.json
```

ci-bot: Canary queued for newdawn-lora:v1 -> id 77222. 6k tokens scheduled. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/77222

mike: I'll run token-diff baseline <-> newdawn-v1 and see if '.' or money tokens moved. Command: 
```
python tools/token_diff.py --base models/base_tok.json --new models/newdawn_tok.json --out /tmp/tokdiff_newdawn.csv
```
If there are merged tokens like ",200" or ".80" we'll craft alias mappings.

tara: Re-ran with adapter-alias + no-fast-bpe + kv-cache. Decimal error rate reduced substantially; EM recovered ~0.9pts but still a handful of spacing issues ("7.80USD"). int8-hybrid kept spacing intact.

eve: That suggests two causes: (1) tokenizer id remap for '.' and adjacent digit tokens, (2) quant decode merge amplified by int4 grouping. If alias fixes >80% we can add loader shim; otherwise block canary.

token-diff-bot: token-diff output uploaded: /tmp/tokdiff_newdawn.csv. Findings: newdawn-v1 merged ".80" into single token id 7742 and renamed "<AMT>" -> "<money_new>" with new id.

mike: I'll prototype a minimal alias mapping to split merged suffix tokens and remap <money_new> back to <AMT>. Prototype script: 
```
python tools/make_alias.py --tokdiff /tmp/tokdiff_newdawn.csv --out /tmp/newdawn_alias.json --split-suffixes .80,.50 --map-tokens <money_new>:<AMT>
```
Kicking a canary with alias now.

ci-bot: Canary 77222 update: alias applied -> errors dropped from 0.88% to 0.22%. p50 67ms, p95 195ms. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/newdawn/77222

tara: After alias + kv-cache + no-fast-bpe, decimals and most spacing issues resolved. int4 EM loss now 0.25pts which is below threshold. We should still run a quant-resweep (gptq group size 128 -> 64) to minimize residual differences before wider rollout.

eve: Plan: (1) add quickpack_money to long-term regressions (newdawn-reg-v1), (2) bake alias into loader for lora_v2_layout if it passes one more full quickpack sweep, (3) schedule quant-resweep. Owners: @eve (owner), @mike (tokenizer), @tara (eval).

mike: Will add targeted unit tests for merged-suffix tokens and push alias to staging.

eve: Great. If any regression pops up after the next canary we'll block rollout and revert. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
